Through his first five games, Wade averaged 3.6 points in 27.8 minutes and shot 30% from three. That points to low scoring involvement even with real minutes, which leaves little margin over a 3.5 line.

Powell's 2026-27 averages are 19.3 pts, 2.5 reb and 1.6 ast in 28.8 min, about 23.4 PRA, almost exactly the 23.5 line. In his 2 home games he averaged 24 pts, 2 reb and 2.5 ast in 34.5 min, which points to the over at home. This page had no injury designation for him.

In the Nov 2 game against these 76ers, Powell had 18 pts, 3 reb and 0 ast (21 PRA) on 5-13 shooting in 28 min. Chicago lost 126-107, and rookie Caleb Wilson led the Bulls with 24, showing Powell shares shots with other scorers.

His last 5 games came to 14, 21, 21, 34 and 23 PRA, so he cleared 23.5 only twice. He played just 22 min in a 34-point loss at the Knicks, and Bulls (1-7) vs. 76ers (8-2) carries a similar blowout risk.
ESPN's 2026-27 game log shows Portis averaging only 8.3 points on 39.7% shooting so far with Miami, which points to lower offensive volume than in his Milwaukee years.

In the Oct 26 loss to Dallas, Portis went 3-6 from three in 24 minutes off the bench. RotoWire says he keeps struggling from the floor and his role should stay somewhat limited while Giannis and Adebayo are healthy.

Portis is expected to be one of Miami's first players off the bench. Playing next to Giannis and Adebayo could cut his opportunities, though he has shot at least 35% from three in each of his past nine seasons. This search found no game-day injury report or analyst pick for this Heat-Kings game.

CBS/RotoWire lists Edgecombe at 12.5 PPG, below the 13.5 line. It calls him likely the fifth option and says his scoring swings with whether James, Embiid, Brown and Maxey play; he missed a game in late October with an abdominal bruise before being cleared.

NBA.com's Nov 7 fantasy note says he scored 19 points with a season-high four steals and no turnovers in the Nov 6 loss at Cleveland. This game at Chicago tips at 3:30 pm ET, and the page also notes frontcourt absences (Bona, Barlow).

The preview for the Nov 2 meeting said Chicago was allowing a league-worst 129.3 points per game. Edgecombe then scored 21 on 9-of-12 shooting in 33 minutes in that 126-107 Philly win, though he shot unusually well that night.
